description: This dataset is a set of building scenes in aerial and satellite imagery with bounding-box annotations for training building detectors. It was prepared by Muhammad Owais Raza and Ali Furkan Kamanlı of Sakarya University of Applied Sciences, Türkiye, and published on Zenodo on 30 December 2025. Images are cut from large tiles from OpenAerialMap and Google Earth at resolutions from 0.3 metres to 1 centimetre per pixel, across urban and rural scenes with varied lighting and seasons: 2,984 training and 746 validation images, plus two small unseen test sets of complex scenes. Annotations are in YOLOv8 format. Access: zip archives of about 0.76 GB, open download. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 on the record, but part of the imagery derives from Google Earth, whose terms may restrict reuse. Coverage: locations are not listed in the record. Caveats: bounding boxes, not footprints, and a small sample. Simulation uses are training building detection models that populate exposure inventories where no footprint data exist. Related records: the Duke aerial imagery dataset and the IEEE GRSS DFC23 benchmark.
